intro: A personal loan with a fixed rate and a set term. Good for full mouth restoration and All-on-X, where the amount is larger.

site.label: Check your options with LendingClub →
site.note: Soft credit check. Does not affect your score.

steps.t: Check your rate online in minutes with a soft check
Choose your term and see the exact monthly payment
Funds go to Xiluet. You pay LendingClub monthly

faq.q: Does checking my rate hurt my credit?
faq.a: No. Checking your rate is a soft inquiry. A hard inquiry happens only if you accept a loan.
LendingClub charges an origination fee that is deducted from the loan amount. Your coordinator will show the net figure.
Typically within a few business days of approval.

disclaimer: LendingClub is a third-party lender. Financing is subject to credit approval. Terms and rates are set by LendingClub and may change. Xiluet does not make credit decisions.
